securityNotice.message: Your API key is encrypted before it's saved (AES-GCM, with a non-extractable key kept in this browser profile) and never leaves this device except to authenticate requests to api.meta.ai. Someone with full access to your computer account could still recover it, so only save it on a trusted device - or enable session-only mode, which keeps the key in memory and forgets it when the browser closes.

keyHygiene.message: Create a dedicated key just for this extension, paste it only into the official Web Store install or a build you made yourself from this repo (a modified clone could steal it), and revoke it anytime in the dev.meta.ai dashboard.

consentBody.message: Analyzing sends the clicked image (its web address or, for inline images, captured frames, and on-demand retries, its pixels), nearby page text (title, captions, metadata), and the page's address to Meta's Muse API using your key. For private images, the image's address itself can grant access to it. Scanning a page sends that page's travel images and their captions the same way (even when the "image only" toggle is on), and planning a trip from your board sends the pinned thumbnails, their place names, and the addresses of the sites you pinned them from. Meta may run web searches to ground the trip guide. Per Meta's API terms, standard (non-contributor) models are not trained on your content.
